title: Ambient, two-step CO2-to-CaCO3 conversion: alkali-activated H2O2-promoted carbonate CO2 capture and direct calcite mineralization
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00210B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Eugene Shirman, Yoel Sasson
We demonstrate an ambient-temperature two-step CO2-to-CaCO3 conversion in which alkali-activated H2O2 accelerates carbonate CO2 capture, followed by calcite mineralization upon CaCl2 addition, without thermal stripping of the capture liquor.
